summary: Confirmed the crash is cp1252-piped-stdout (subprocess capture bypasses PEP-528 console UTF-8), inventoried 9 non-ASCII print-path sites across models/structure.py and bimodal/exclusion/imposition semantic/model.py (2 beyond the traceback's own list), and found the alignment math/comments already assume ASCII-width arrows. Recommends stream-encoding-aware ASCII fallback (probe output.encoding, substitute glyphs) over global UTF-8 reconfiguration or ASCII-only, since the required cp1252-TextIOWrapper test targets the output parameter, not sys.stdout. Also flagged an adjacent, currently non-triggering risk in output/progress/display.py's TerminalDisplay (isatty gate disabled).
